programme.title: The World of Hammer
programme.desc: Chiller. 1994. Narrated by Oliver Reed. A look at Hammer's 'mini-Hitchcocks'; a series of suspense thrillers with a twist in the tale such as Maniac, Paranoiac, The Last Page and Shatter.

programme.title: The World of Hammer
programme.desc: The Curse of Frankenstein. 1994. Narrated by Oliver Reed. A look at Hammer's controversially popular cycle of Frankenstein films, reborn as explicit gothic horrors in gloriously gory colour.

programme.title: EuroTrash
programme.desc: 1994. Hosted by Antoine de Caunes and Jean Paul Gaultier. Amanda Lear is in the studio to be interviewed by Jean-Paul Gaultier and meet the man who has been living in Charles de Gaulle airport.

programme.title: One Million AC/DC
programme.desc: 1969. Fantasy. Director: Ed De Priest. Stars: Susan Berkely, Billy Wolf & Sharon Wells. When a primitive tribe meet a rival clan and a giant ape, lust and violence collide in a bizarre melodrama.

programme.title: Jail Bait (1954)
programme.desc: 1954. Crime. Director: Edward D. Wood Jr. Stars Lyle Talbot & Dolores Fuller. A young man is drawn into the life of crime and then blackmails a plastic surgeon to change his face to evade the law.

programme.title: How To Undress in Public
programme.desc: 1965. Comedy. Directed by Compton Bennett. Stars Fenella Fielding, Reginald Beckwith & Kenneth Connor. A comedic take on the different methods of undressing through the ages.

programme.title: The Adventures of Sir Lancelot
programme.desc: Sir Bliant. 1956. Stars William Russell, Cyril Smith & Ronald Leigh-Hunt. Sir Bliant's three sons decide to break the truce King Arthur arranged between their father and Sir Rolf.

programme.title: Stingray
programme.desc: Set Sail for Adventure. 1964. Stars Lois Maxwell, Robert Easton & David Graham. Phones and Lt Fisher take up a challenge to become members of Admiral Denver's crew on an ancient sailing vessel.

programme.title: Look At Life Music by the Mile
programme.desc: 1967. An incredible look at piped music, with a focus on how it is produced and networked.

programme.title: The Monkey's Paw
programme.desc: 1948. Horror. A curio dealer sells a monkey's paw that can grant the possessor three wishes but warns that disaster will follow. Starring Michael Martin-Harvey, Sydney Tafler & Alfie Bass.

programme.title: Sandokan: Pirate of Malaysia
programme.desc: 1964. Action. Director: Umberto Lenzi. Stars Steve Reeves, Jacqueline Sassard & Mimmo Palmara. Sandokan and his team of rebels attempt to stop a British General from forcing the Sultan to resign.

programme.title: The Naked Hills
programme.desc: 1956. Western. Directed by Josef Shaftel. Stars David Wayne, Keenan Wynn & James Barton. An Indiana farmer develops an insatiable thirst for gold and sets off to find fortune in California.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: A Man for Elly. 1964. Stars Irene Ryan, Donna Douglas & Henry Gibson. Granny spends her time watching her television idol, Western actor Quirt Manly and believes he would be just the man for Elly.

programme.title: Biggles: Adventures in Time
programme.desc: 1986. Sci-Fi. Director: John Hough. Stars Peter Cushing, Neil Dickson, Alex Hyde-White. The daring flying ace takes on his arch rival aided by a British intelligence officer and a time traveller.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Batman Displays His Knowledge. 1967. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Alan Napier. Catwoman realizes she has been tricked and vows to get revenge on the Caped Crusader once and for all.

programme.title: Any Man's Kingdom 1956
programme.desc: 1956. Directed by Tony Thompson. Narrated by Stephen Murray. An interesting and atmospheric travelogue focusing on the scenery, history and residents of Northumberland.

programme.title: For Those In Peril
programme.desc: 1944. War Drama. Director: Charles Crichton. Stars David Farrar, Ralph Michael & Robert Wyndham. A WWII flyer fails to join the RAF so he joins the Air - Sea Rescue instead.

programme.title: Give Us A Clue
programme.desc: 1985. Hosted by Michael Parkinson. Celebrity guests Jay Aston, Bobby Gee, Roy Kinnear, Susan Penhaligon and Sylvia Syms mime iconic titles and phrases to compete and win points!

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: The Giuoco Piano Affair. 1964. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum & Leo G. Carroll. Solo and Kuryakin pursue the only surviving conspirators of The Quadripartite Affair.

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: Ahoy Radio Caroline fans, a very rare reel takes us behind the scenes in 1965. Enjoy a beautiful reel of some heritage trains from 1968 and Mike and Noel talk Man From U.N.C.L.E Membership!

programme.title: Hannay
programme.desc: The Fellowship of the Black Stone. 1988. Stars Robert Powell, Christopher Scoular & Gavin Richards. Hannay is recognised as an officer in military intelligence, an engineer & a prospector.

programme.title: That's My Boy
programme.desc: Live as Family. 1981. Stars Mollie Sugden, Christopher Blake & Jennifer Lonsdale. Ida Willis takes a job as housekeeper. Dr Robert Price wants to fire Ida, until he finds out who she really is.

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: The Rattan Trunk. 1955. Stars Ron Randell, Peter Grant & Jan Holden. Bert Edwards receives a trunk full of Persian rugs. Soon after the luggage turns up at Euston Station with a body inside.

programme.title: Memories of Making Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: Acclaimed actor William Gaunt describes filming live to bring the series alive.

programme.title: Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: The Case of the Big Ben Lewis. 1964. Stars John Barrie, William Gaunt & Charles Morgan. Six men are to be hanged for murdering Sir James Gilbert. Big Ben Lewis is fighting their case.

programme.title: Turn The Key Softly
programme.desc: 1953. Drama. Director: Jack Lee. Stars Yvonne Mitchell, Joan Collins, Kathleen Harrison. Three women are released from Holloway prison on the same morning into the bustle of post-war London.

programme.title: The Nudist Story
programme.desc: 1960. Drama. Director: Ramsey Herrington. Stars Shelley Martin, Brian Cobby, Natalie Lynn. A woman is horrified when she inherits a nudist camp but her views are challenged when she falls in love.

programme.title: The Heritage Chart Show with Mike Read
programme.desc: A TOTP style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.

programme.title: Blonde Fist
programme.desc: 1991. Drama. Director: Frank Clarke. Stars Margi Clarke, Carroll Baker & Ken Hutchison. Ronnie flees domestic life to find her father in New York and ends up boxing to make ends meet.

programme.title: Every Day Except Christmas (1957)
programme.desc: A study of working class life, but with an affectionate appreciation of the hard-working Covent Garden market porters. Created with Walter Lassally's virtuoso 35mm cinematography.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: A Guest for The Gallows. 1955. Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf & Archie Duncan. For obvious reasons, Robin and the Sheriff are sworn enemies. Why then should the Sheriff seek Robin's help?

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: Whale Gold. 1956. Stars Robert Shaw, Noel Purcell & Wilfred Downing. The crew learn that ambergris, used to make perfume, is worth more than gold, causing greed to spread through the group.

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Prisoner. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard, Jennifer Jayne & Michael Caine. On his way to deliver a message to William Tell, a resistance man is captured and taken to a fortress.

programme.title: Johnny Ringo
programme.desc: Single Debt. Directed by Aaron Spelling. After a long absence and reeking of alcohol, Ringo calls out two cowboys from a saloon and guns them down. The Mayor demands an explanation.

programme.title: Down Among The Z Men
programme.desc: 1952. Comedy directed by Maclean Rogers and starring Michael Bentine, Harry Secombe, Spike Milligan and Peter Sellers. Prof. Pureheart loses a secret formula in the grocery shop.

programme.title: The Gloster Stretcher Ladder
programme.desc: 1957. A charming and fascinating short film detailing the careful construction of the Gloster Stretcher Ladder, used to transport patients safely.

programme.title: Great Day In The Morning
programme.desc: 1956. Western. A gambler wins a hotel in a card game but finds himself involved with women and the start of the civil war. Starring Robert Stack, Virginia Mayo & Ruth Roman.

programme.title: The Large Rope
programme.desc: (AKA: The Long Rope). 1953. Drama. Director: Wolf Rilla. Stars Donald Houston, Susan Shaw & Peter Byrne. A man returns to where he was accused of murdering a girl to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Look At Life Cool Cats
programme.desc: 1965. A marvellous look at the world of cats from the rare to the new breeds, including the fashionable Siamese.
